messages:
Hana L.: hi! noticed the orientation on my calendar says 08:00 but the Zoom invite in the event is missing. im in SGT (UTC+8) — anyone else seeing no link? :thinking_face:
Onboarding Bot: Hello Hana! Official Zoom link: https://zoom.us/j/2468101214 (passcode: `redwood-onboard`). ICS: https://redwood.app/ical/newhire_main.ics. If the link is missing, try re-accepting the invite from People Ops.
Devon K.: thanks bot. for timezone conversions: 08:00 SGT = 20:00 PT (prev day) = 23:00 ET (prev day) = 04:00 BST (next day). will add a quick table in the event notes.
Maya R.: also heads up  some companies send duplicate invites if team leads added the event manually. if you have two events, accept the one from "People Ops" and decline the other to avoid duplicates in your calendar app.
Hana L.: accepted the People Ops invite and now i see the Zoom. quick Q: will the recording include the slides?
People Ops: yes, we'll record the main session and upload the video + slide deck to Drive under "Onboarding / Sessions". Link will be posted in this channel after processing (~1 hour).
Devon K.: for APAC folks who can't join live, RSVP "No" and we'll send the recording + timestamps. also we'll pin a short FAQ with local times for common APAC zones (SGT, AEST, NZDT, IST).
Hana L.: perfect. tiny accessibility question: will live captions be on?
People Ops: live captions will be enabled. if you need a language other than English, DM us and we'll arrange extra support where possible.
Maya R.: one more calendar tip: if youre on Outlook and see wrong local time after accepting, right-click event > "Open in browser" > re-sync with the .ics. fixed it for me.
Hana L.: thanks everyone 64b see you tomorrow! :wave:
